text.content:
One of the two voices on every screen.

Headquarters: N54 HQ (#25), Downtown: studios, a newsroom and a sixty-meter screen facing the Spaceport Causeway
Industry: News and broadcast vid
Leadership: Star anchor: Seraphina Lumet
In Night City: With WNS, its rival and mirror, controls nearly all broadcast TV and most of the news

N54 and WNS between them own the airwaves and the cable lines in Night City, and most other outlets buy their content. They decide, with the other megacorps, what gets covered and what gets buried; both are owned by people who own other things.

Lyle Thompson has been fired from N54 twice, and still has the footage it cut: the Mox riots of 2067 (it ran four seconds), and a man on his roof as the water rose over Laguna Bend in 2062. Pirate stations fill the gaps it leaves, from Samizdat Radio to the Haitian stations of Coastview. Retired rockerboy Gloria Vane sold her catalog to N54 in 2055.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.30; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05, 07
